test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: On which of the following rivers does the National Waterway- 2 lie that covers the Sadiya - Dhubri stretch?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Waterway-2:-**

 
 
• **NW-2 is a designated inland waterway in India that runs along the Brahmaputra River in the state of Assam.**
 
• It stretches for 891 kilometers (554 miles) from Dhubri on the Bangladesh border to Sadiya in the easternmost part of the state.
 
• NW-2 is one of the most important national waterways in India, providing a crucial transportation link for the northeastern region of the country. 
 
 
 
• **Brahmaputra River:-**
 
 
• The Brahmaputra, one of the largest rivers of the world, has its origin in the Chemayungdung glacier of the Kailash range near the Mansarovar lake.
 
• It emerges as a turbulent and dynamic river after carving out a deep gorge in the Central Himalayas near Namcha Barwa (7,755 m).
 
• The river emerges from the foothills under the name of Siang or Dihang. It enters India west of Sadiya town in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• Flowing southwest, it receives its main left bank tributaries, viz., Dibang or Sikang and Lohit; thereafter, it is known as the Brahmaputra.
 
• The Brahmaputra River is a major source of water for irrigation and hydroelectric power, and it also supports a rich biodiversity of plants and animals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ganges River:-**

 
 
• It is a sacred river to Hindus and is considered one of the holiest rivers in the world.
 
• It originates in the Himalayas and flows through India and Bangladesh before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The Ganges River is a major source of water for irrigation and drinking water, and it also supports a rich biodiversity of plants and animals.
 
 
 
• **Krishna River:-**
 
 
• It is the fourth longest river in India. It originates in the Western Ghats and flows through the states of Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The Krishna River is a major source of water for irrigation and hydroelectric power, and it also supports a rich agricultural economy.
 
 
 
• **Godavari River:-**
 
 
• It is the second longest river in India. It originates in the Western Ghats and flows through the states of Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Odisha before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The Godavari River is a major source of water for irrigation and drinking water, and it also supports a rich agricultural economy.
